key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 (immediate evacuation) for coastal areas including Eastern Samar and Leyte.
Evacuations took place; surveyed barangays reported about 80% of residents evacuated after the alert.
Warning delays occurred; in parts of Guiuan the alert arrived after the expected wave travel time; time was also tight in Leyte.
Communication and power issues during the alert, including major power cuts and mobile network problems; one municipality had incorrect radio information.
No significant tsunami wave was observed; PHIVOLCS later cancelled the alert and no damages were reported.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred… east of the southern tip of Eastern Samar.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3, meaning immediate evacuation… including… Eastern Samar, Leyte…
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of the residents evacuating after the alert.
missing_information: Exact list of all evacuating barangays not specified
Tsunami impacts were negligible/absent near the Philippine coast
